note: Since 29 September 2025 the Roblox Player only reads Fast Flags on Roblox's official allowlist; anything else is silently ignored. BrainStrap marks every setting with its allowlist status and, by default, only writes allowlisted flags. Roblox can change the list at any time.

flags.name: Graphics API
flags.desc: Forces a renderer. Leave on Default unless something is broken.
flags.doc: Roblox normally picks the best renderer for your GPU. Forcing Direct3D 11 can fix crashes on old or unusual drivers; Vulkan can help some AMD cards; OpenGL is a last resort.

flags.name: Anti-aliasing (MSAA)
flags.desc: Smooths jagged edges. Higher costs more GPU time.
flags.doc: Multi-sample anti-aliasing renders edges several times. Off is fastest; 4x and 8x look smoother but cost a lot on laptop and older GPUs.

flags.name: Texture quality
flags.desc: Overrides texture resolution. Lower uses less video memory.
flags.doc: Sets how sharp textures are, no matter what Roblox's automatic graphics picks. Lower values free video memory, which helps GPUs with 2-4 GB.

flags.name: Quality level lock
flags.desc: Locks Roblox's graphics quality level (1 to 21).
flags.doc: Roblox's automatic graphics keeps raising and lowering quality, which causes stutter. Locking a level keeps frames steady. It is a debug flag, so Roblox may change how it behaves.

flags.name: Grass
flags.desc: Removes terrain grass, a cheap FPS win on grassy maps.
flags.doc: Sets how far away terrain grass is drawn. Off removes it entirely.

flags.name: Still grass
flags.doc: Reduced-motion setting for grass. Calmer to look at and slightly cheaper to draw.

flags.name: Detail distance
flags.desc: Switches detailed parts to simpler versions sooner.
flags.doc: Controls when unions and meshes (CSG) swap to lower-detail versions as they get further away. 'Performance' swaps immediately, which helps on large detailed maps.

flags.name: Freeze lighting updates
flags.desc: Stops recalculating voxel lighting. Faster on old PCs, but lighting won't react to moving objects.
flags.doc: A debug flag that pauses the voxelizer that updates lighting. Big help on very weak hardware; shadows and light may look wrong when things move.

flags.name: Plain gray sky
flags.desc: Replaces the skybox with flat gray.
flags.doc: A debug flag that removes the sky texture. Mostly a visual preference; tiny savings on video memory.

flags.name: Ignore Windows display scaling
flags.desc: Stops Roblox from scaling its window with your Windows display scale.
flags.doc: Useful on high-DPI laptops where Roblox's interface looks too big or blurry.

flags.name: Alt+Enter fullscreen fix
flags.desc: Hands Alt+Enter back to Windows. Try it if fullscreen toggling misbehaves.
flags.doc: Changes who handles the Alt+Enter fullscreen shortcut.

flags.name: FPS cap
flags.manual: Roblox ignores this flag now. In a game, open Roblox's Settings and set Maximum Frame Rate to {value}.
flags.desc: Not on Roblox's allowlist. Use Roblox's own Maximum Frame Rate setting instead.
flags.doc: The old FPS-unlock flag. Since the allowlist it does nothing, but Roblox added an official Maximum Frame Rate option in its in-game settings, which BrainStrap points you to.

flags.name: Lighting technology
flags.doc: Used to force Voxel, ShadowMap or Future lighting. Roblox now ignores these flags.

flags.name: Disable post-processing
flags.doc: Used to turn off bloom and blur. Roblox now ignores it.

flags.name: FPS counter flag
flags.desc: Not on Roblox's allowlist. Use BrainHUD or Shift+F5 in Roblox instead.
flags.doc: Used to show a debug FPS counter. Roblox's own Shift+F5 stats and BrainHUD replace it.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.desc: Steady frames with Roblox's look intact.

presets.name: Performance
presets.desc: Drops the expensive effects for more FPS.

presets.name: Quality
presets.desc: Sharper and smoother edges, for a strong GPU.

presets.name: Potato
presets.desc: For very old laptops. Lowest everything.
